bullets.tex: Shipped \textbf{2 React Native apps} (residents; drivers \& staff) and a \textbf{Next.js ops console} from one pnpm monorepo with shared UI, API and type packages; releases versioned with Changesets, built on EAS in GitHub Actions.

Wrote a custom \textbf{Expo native module in Swift + Kotlin} over a vendor \textbf{Bluetooth} SDK so residents unlock smart lockers from their phone; locker secrets encrypted at rest with \textbf{AES-256-GCM}.

Designed a 4-stage \textbf{AI care-tag scanner}: \textbf{Claude Vision} extracts label facts via forced-JSON tool use, a deterministic rules engine decides, and a confidence gate fails safe before residents see a verdict.

Cut up to \textbf{60\,s of queueing delay} from every \textbf{Salesforce Agentforce} chat reply by replacing cron dispatch with synchronous, per-session serialized calls; also integrated Salesforce CRM, e-paper labels and OSRM routing.

Built the \textbf{Expo} app end to end: personalized onboarding, programs, \textbf{offline downloads}, \textbf{Agora} live classes, \textbf{7 languages with full RTL} (Arabic) and PostHog product analytics.

Built an \textbf{AI wellness coach} on \textbf{GPT-4o-mini}: a regex intent router picks the tool strategy, then up to 3 rounds of \textbf{function calling} across 5 catalog tools stream to the app over \textbf{SSE}, with Whisper voice input and a prompt-injection guard.

Built \textbf{RAG} on \textbf{pgvector} (text-embedding-3-small, HNSW cosine index) with a plain-query fallback when embeddings are missing; every suggested ID is re-verified in the database, so invented or unpublished content never reaches users.

Added \textbf{long-term memory}: stated preferences and dislikes become durable exclusions, chats past 10 messages are summarized, and onboarding, mood and streak personalize replies; graded by 28 mocked tests plus live OpenAI scorecards.
Built \textbf{encrypted HLS} delivery (S3 $\rightarrow$ MediaConvert $\rightarrow$ CloudFront signed URLs), with \textbf{Redis} playback grants that keep progress heartbeats off the database.
